assets.prompt: Redrawn at 2x detail (two art pixels a world pixel, drawn at half size in the game) from its 1x art with the same layout, frames and silhouette: its diagonals smoothed to one-pixel steps and its outside outline one art pixel thick, then given new detail at the finer pixels: each material's surface on every shade of a part's inside (bone pitted with pores, wood grain in broken streaks along each part's length, a light speckle on the void, the same in every frame of a strip; a body's Stone shadow made its base) and a one-pixel lit edge on each part's top-left and a shaded one on its bottom-right (Stone kept at its base there); palette colours only. The 1x art's prompt: The Bone Scepter, a stray: a Bone skull with dark Void eye sockets (the face layer lights them) and a toothed jaw on a Wood stick with a Void ring and a Void ferrule. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eyes and brows) is a separate layer. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
